_comment: Curated subset of common JavaScript library CVEs (affected functions + exploitation conditions). Online lookups (GitHub Advisory Database) complement it.

CVE-2020-11022.summary: Passing HTML from untrusted sources to jQuery DOM manipulation methods may execute untrusted code, even after sanitizing it (htmlPrefilter regex).
CVE-2020-11022.conditions: Attacker-influenced HTML string reaches a jQuery DOM manipulation method.

CVE-2020-11023.summary: Passing HTML containing <option> elements from untrusted sources to jQuery DOM manipulation methods may execute untrusted code.
CVE-2020-11023.conditions: Attacker-influenced HTML containing <option> elements reaches a DOM manipulation method.

CVE-2019-11358.summary: jQuery.extend(true, {}, ...) deep merge of an untrusted object can pollute Object.prototype via __proto__.
CVE-2019-11358.conditions: Deep extend (first argument true) with an object parsed from untrusted input.

CVE-2015-9251.summary: Cross-domain Ajax requests without a dataType execute text/javascript responses.
CVE-2015-9251.conditions: Ajax request to an attacker-controlled cross-origin URL without an explicit dataType.

CVE-2012-6708.summary: jQuery(strInput) can interpret a selector string as HTML even when it does not start with '<', leading to XSS.
CVE-2012-6708.conditions: An attacker-influenced string is passed to $() as a selector.

CVE-2011-4969.summary: XSS when location.hash is used as a selector.

CVE-2020-7656.summary: The load() method fails to strip <script> tags containing whitespace in the closing tag, so loaded HTML can execute scripts.

CVE-2021-41182.summary: XSS in the altField option of the Datepicker widget.
CVE-2021-41182.conditions: The altField option is set from untrusted input.

CVE-2021-41183.summary: XSS in the *Text options (e.g. closeText, currentText) of the Datepicker widget.
CVE-2021-41183.conditions: Datepicker *Text options come from untrusted input.

CVE-2021-41184.summary: XSS in the 'of' option of the .position() utility.
CVE-2021-41184.conditions: The 'of' option is set from untrusted input.

CVE-2022-31160.summary: Initializing a checkboxradio widget on an input enclosed in a label makes the label's HTML be re-parsed, which can execute scripts.

CVE-2016-7103.summary: XSS in the closeText option of the Dialog widget.
CVE-2016-7103.conditions: closeText is set from untrusted input.

CVE-2019-10744.summary: Prototype pollution in defaultsDeep with constructor payloads.
CVE-2019-10744.conditions: defaultsDeep merges an object parsed from untrusted input.

CVE-2020-8203.conditions: zipObjectDeep is called with untrusted property paths.

CVE-2021-23337.summary: Command/code injection through the 'variable' option of _.template.

CVE-2018-16487.summary: Prototype pollution in merge, mergeWith and defaultsDeep.
CVE-2018-16487.conditions: Deep merge of an object parsed from untrusted input.

CVE-2018-3721.summary: Prototype pollution in merge, mergeWith and defaultsDeep via __proto__.
CVE-2018-3721.conditions: Deep merge of an object parsed from untrusted input.

CVE-2021-23358.summary: Arbitrary code execution through the 'variable' setting of _.template.

CVE-2019-8331.summary: XSS in the tooltip/popover data-template, data-content and data-title options.
CVE-2019-8331.conditions: Tooltip/popover options come from untrusted input.

CVE-2018-14040.summary: XSS in the collapse data-parent attribute.

CVE-2018-14041.summary: XSS in the scrollspy data-target attribute.

CVE-2018-14042.summary: XSS in the tooltip data-container property.

CVE-2019-19919.summary: Prototype pollution through templates that can lead to remote code execution.
CVE-2019-19919.conditions: Templates are compiled from untrusted input.

CVE-2020-26870.summary: Mutation XSS bypass of the sanitizer.
CVE-2020-26870.conditions: Sanitized output of attacker-controlled HTML is inserted into the DOM.

CVE-2022-31129.summary: Inefficient RFC 2822 date parsing (ReDoS) for long user-supplied strings.
CVE-2022-31129.conditions: Very long attacker-controlled strings are parsed as dates.

CVE-2022-24785.summary: Path traversal in locale loading when the locale name comes from user input (mainly server-side).

CVE-2021-3749.summary: Inefficient regular expression (ReDoS) in the trim helper.

CVE-2023-45857.summary: The XSRF-TOKEN cookie value is sent in the X-XSRF-TOKEN header to any host, leaking it to third parties.
CVE-2023-45857.conditions: Requests to third-party hosts from a context that holds an XSRF-TOKEN cookie.
